origin_diagnosis: B02 loses JPY 12,459 in 2023 while remaining positive in both 2024 halves. The only fixed common-feature subgroup with negative baseline P/L in all three periods was B02 shorts whose side-aligned four-hour M15-open movement was at most 20 pips.
causal_hypothesis: A B02 short breakout without an established four-hour downward open-path is a weak-trend or counter-regime admission whose expected loss exceeds the continuation profit sacrificed by blocking it.
signal_generation: unchanged; blocked signals remain observable but do not create positions
prior_work_reviewed: R1 generic impulse, momentum, trend and ATR directional-change entry universe

novelty.not_generic_trend_strategy: The four-hour path does not create an independent entry signal; it gates only accepted B02 short breakouts.
novelty.not_R1_atr_directional_change: No ATR state machine or independent directional-change entry is used.
novelty.not_F05_families: The target is B02 pre-entry admission, not F05 entry, exposure or exit behavior.
novelty.new_information: direction-specific interaction between the accepted B02 short breakout and the immediately preceding side-aligned four-hour open path under a three-year-compatible historical lineage

finite_grid.block_if: strategy == B02 and side == -1 and side_aligned_open_move_4h_pips <= threshold_pips

threshold_interpretation.0: countertrend or no net four-hour downward alignment
threshold_interpretation.40: require a materially established four-hour downward trend

candidate_counterfactual.blocked_trade_pl: remove the accepted B02 trade's realized P/L from portfolio and strategy totals
candidate_counterfactual.future_signal_generation: unchanged because accepted B02/F05 signals are market-data-defined
candidate_counterfactual.exposure_state: recompute for attribution only; no Family I rule depends on exposure state
candidate_counterfactual.equity_path: recompute from unchanged trade ledgers after removing blocked B02 positions

development_periods.2024_H2: development and cross-regime period under policy v4

required_metrics: candidate total and B02 net/PF by period
blocked trades and entry dates by month/quarter
long B02 and F05 exact invariance

gates.parameter_identifiability: collapse cells with identical blocked trade keys before ranking

ranking: minimum candidate total net across 2023, 2024 H1 and 2024 H2
falsification: no cell makes every development period candidate total net positive with PF at least 1
benefit is date or month concentrated
the selected threshold is outcome-equivalent to another cell
the 2023 deficit remains negative after the strongest eligible cell
prohibited: No threshold other than 0, 20 or 40 after results
No combination with closed Families G or H
No 2025 outcome use for mechanism, threshold or ranking
No MT4 or 2025 access unless one exact finalist passes and is separately frozen
